intermediate.title: KOM Sprint | Castelnuovo Val di Cecina (148.3 km)

story: An early four-rider break gained about four minutes before Ineos Grenadiers and Visma–Lease a Bike controlled the race and caught them with 40 km left. On the sterrato section, Mathieu van der Poel attacked with Jorgenson crashing behind him and eventually sprinted to victory ahead of Isaac del Toro and Giulio Pellizzari, with Del Toro taking the overall lead.
